U04_A.summary: Unit U04 is correct. I re-derived every statement and inference of s03_gauge_2/3/4 by hand: the one-pole definition, the quintic system, equal products and v(u), the commutant, lifting and scalar-equation lemmas, Theorem U (a)-(d), the leading-term and Z/5-degree lemmas, graded gauges. Theorem U is fully proved over any field of characteristic 0, without circularity. No fatal error, gap or fixable error; four minor points only (one loosely worded clause on the closing relation, an unnamed ring, notation clashes, two one-line omissions). Two independent exact-arithmetic checks (construction of P-natural to z^3 for a random pair; rank-one leading term by linear algebra) agree with the text.

findings.title: Closing-relation clause of prop:gau-quintic (i) asserts nothing provable at that point
findings.label: prop:gau-quintic
findings.claim: After transporting the forward relations a=0..3 through the conifold expansion, the text says the closing relation "is then given by" cor:gau-cycsys (proof: "is cor:gau-cycsys (ii) with w = zeta^i/s").
findings.problem: cor:gau-cycsys (ii) is only an equivalence with PF_5-shifted(varpi_0 Cexp(X_0)) = 0, known here only for q-series. Harmless: later uses take a<=3; closing relation is proved in thm:gau-R0 (iv), cor:gau-colours.
findings.repair: Reword: by cor:gau-cycsys (ii) the closing relation for the expansions is equivalent to PF_5^{(i)}(varpi_0 Cexp(X_0)) = 0; for the rows it is obtained in thm:gau-R0 (iv) and cor:gau-colours.

findings.title: Regular gauge: ring of invertibility of P_0 not named
findings.label: def:gau-onepole
findings.claim: A regular gauge is an element of Gau(A, Atilde) with P_0 invertible.
findings.problem: Invertible over k[[u]] or over k((u)) is not said. Closes by thm:gau-U (b): P_0 = c(0) d Theta_U is zero or has unit diagonal entries, so both readings agree.

findings.title: Notation clashes: prime, Y, v, zeta
findings.label: lem:gau-lift
findings.claim: Prime is d/du throughout the subsection; Y denotes the inverse of Atilde; v(u) is the fixed series u tau^{-5/4}; zeta is a complex number.
findings.problem: Z' and c' are other objects, not derivatives; Y is also an arbitrary matrix in comm (d); v is first arbitrary then fixed; for abstract k, zeta must mean a primitive fifth root of unity.
findings.repair: Rename the primed objects and the dummy matrix; say 'a primitive fifth root of unity'.

findings.title: Two one-line omissions in the proof of Theorem U
findings.label: thm:gau-U
findings.claim: Lifting is applied to each shift component of X_{k+1}; in (d) every object is obtained by field operations, derivatives and the formal integral.
findings.problem: Needs pr of each shift component to vanish (pr preserves the shift, comm (e)); the list omits the binomial fifth root defining d (rational by scal (d)). Both close in one line.

coverage.label: def:gau-onepole
coverage.note: Self-duality identity, module structure, gauge transport rechecked; ring for 'P_0 invertible' unnamed (harmless by Theorem U (b)).

coverage.label: prop:gau-quintic
coverage.note: kappa, b, residue -1, product -1/(u(1-u)^5), values at 0, (iii) rechecked; closing-relation clause of (i) loosely worded. Relies on lem:gau-confexp, cor:gau-cycsys.

coverage.label: prop:gau-equalprod
coverage.note: All three parts re-derived; (ii) also confirmed to O(u^20) in exact arithmetic.

coverage.label: thm:gau-U
coverage.note: Parts (a)-(d) fully checked, no circularity; two one-line omissions in the proof; construction confirmed numerically to z^3.

coverage.label: lem:gau-comm
coverage.note: Parts (a)-(g) re-derived, including projection formula, Gram matrix, integrality criterion, Eisenstein.

coverage.label: lem:gau-lift
coverage.note: Telescoping equation and integrality checked case by case for m = 0..4; uniqueness modulo integral commutant.

coverage.label: lem:gau-scal
coverage.note: Projection of derivative and dlog terms, chi_j = j/(5u) + regular, recursion pivots n + j/5, j = 0 integrating factor all rechecked.

coverage.label: lem:gau-lead
coverage.note: Leading coefficient c d Theta_U; rank-one projection also confirmed by brute-force linear algebra.

coverage.note: Each of the three terms of ge raises the Z/5-degree by one.

U04_B.summary: Unit U04 (def:gau-onepole to prop:gau-graded) is sound: I found no error and no unclosed gap. Every statement was re-derived by hand, including mod-5 wrap-arounds, pole/integrality bookkeeping in the lifting and scalar lemmas, and gauge/transpose conventions. Theorem U (a),(b) was also confirmed by an independent brute-force linear-algebra computation on a generic pair of one-pole systems with (EP); (EP), (N0) and Mcyc=PF4 were checked to O(u^9) or higher in a generic frame. All downstream citations use Theorem U only for integral gauges, as proved. Only two minor findings: an imprecise clause on the closing relation in prop:gau-quintic (i), and notation clashes.

findings.title: Closing relation in prop:gau-quintic (i) asserted without its hypothesis
findings.label: prop:gau-quintic
findings.claim: For elements X_a of N((z)) tensor Q(zeta) satisfying the forward relations (a=0..3), the conifold expansion carries these over, and 'the closing relation is then given by cor:gau-cycsys' (proof: 'is cor:gau-cycsys (ii) with w = zeta^i s^{-1}').
findings.problem: cor:gau-cycsys (ii) is an equivalence: the closing relation holds iff varpi_0 Cexp(X_0) solves the twisted PF5. That hypothesis is not stated; it holds for the rows only by thm:gau-R0 (iii)/(iv), proved later.
findings.repair: Say: the closing relation is equivalent, by cor:gau-cycsys (ii), to PF5^{(i)}(varpi_0 Cexp(X_0)) = 0, and for the rows is proved in thm:gau-R0 (iv). Later proofs quote (i) only for a <= 3 (thm:gau-R0 (iv), cor:gau-rowsNN), so nothing downstream changes.

findings.title: Notation clashes within the unit
findings.label: lem:gau-comm
findings.claim: Letters Y, Z, r, R^{(n)}, \Bprod and i are each used with two meanings (generic matrix vs solution vector vs A~^{-1}; residue vs residue class mod 5; remainder vs R-matrix; product of A vs of A~; summation index vs colour).
findings.problem: Purely notational; \Bprod changes from the product of A (def:gau-onepole) to that of A~ (sec:gau-U, lem:gau-comm without (EP)). No effect on validity.
findings.repair: Rename the local letters (e.g. the generic matrix in the proof of lem:gau-comm (d), the residue class in prop:gau-graded (ii), the remainder in the proof of Theorem U (b)).

U03_A.summary: Unit U03 (Appendices A and B, first part of Section 3) is sound. Every statement was checked line by line, every load-bearing formula re-derived by hand, and the non-trivial ones confirmed by my own exact-arithmetic computations (kappa^LR, Wr = L^10, PF_4 p_4 = 1 to q^7; jet and Gram matrices, gamma = 7/10, Mcyc = PF_4 to u^13 in several frames). No fatal error, gap or fixable error; no circularity. Three minor points: an unstated one-line step in lem:gau-conc (iv), notation clashes, and the implicit meaning of "Q = 1" along the line in Appendix A.

findings.title: Unstated use of Conc(f, varpi_1) = 0 in the entries with y_3
findings.label: lem:gau-conc
findings.claim: Conc(f,y_3) = Conc(f,varpi_1) ell + sum D^a f Jet_ab Y_b "is the coefficient of u^0 of the second term".
findings.problem: This needs Conc(f,varpi_1)=0, stated only later (lem:gau-iso (ii)). Not circular: the left side is in Q by part (ii), ell is transcendental over K, so the ell-coefficient vanishes.
findings.repair: Add one sentence: since Conc(f,y_3) lies in Q and the right side has degree at most 1 in ell over K, Conc(f,varpi_1)=0 and the second term is a constant of K, equal to its u^0 coefficient.

findings.title: Notation clashes in and around the unit
findings.label: def:gau-conc
findings.claim: Letters \cP, Y_b, J, Q/q_ab, t, \cR are used with the meanings of the unit.
findings.problem: \cP is a series in App. A and an operator in App. B; Y_b, J, Q, q_ab, t clash with cyclic-system unknowns, J-function, rows, q, t=TH; \cR is declared as weighted rings in macros.tex. No proof is affected.
findings.repair: Declare the local letters local (as done for \mathsf t_j) or rename them.

findings.title: Meaning of 'Q = 1' along the line t = TH left implicit
findings.label: lem:set-grading
findings.claim: With Q=1, <<H^a,H^b,H^c>>(TH) = eta(H^aH^b,H^c) + sum_d e^{dT} <H^a,H^b,H^c>_{0,3,d}, and functions of t are functions of q with d_T = C_1^{-1} D.
findings.problem: At Q=1 the double sum is not a formal series in T; it exists only after divisor-equation resummation. The ring and the chain rule are not stated; they close in two lines.
findings.repair: State: functions along the line lie in Q[T][[E]], E=e^T; T -> T(q), E -> q exp(I~_1/C_0) intertwines d_T with C_1^{-1}D since D T = C_1 and D e^{T(q)} = C_1 e^{T(q)}.
